zh.text: 如果手機掉進馬里亞納海溝，要多久才會沉到底？
旗艦手機的防水，最深只測到六公尺，
九分鐘，一千公尺：陽光完全消失，
只剩深海生物自己發的光。
三十五分鐘，到了鐵達尼號的深度，
就算把聖母峰整座丟進來，
山頂離海面還有兩公里。
每平方公分壓著一點一噸，像一輛小汽車。
光是手機正面，就壓著一百二十噸，像一百多輛車。
1998 年，無人潛艇在海溝底拍到一個塑膠袋。
最快也要一小時四十一分，
夠你把這支片重看九十多遍。

en.text: What if you dropped your phone into the Mariana Trench?
How long until it hits bottom?
Top phones are only water-tested to 6 meters.
The only light now comes from living things.
Only a third of the way down.
and its peak is still 2 kilometers underwater.
Every square centimeter carries 1.1 tonnes. About a small car.
On the phone's front alone: 120 tonnes. Over 100 cars.
But it wouldn't be the first.
In 1998, a robot sub filmed a plastic bag down here.
Even at top speed, it takes 1 hour 41 minutes.
Enough to rewatch this video over 90 times.
So hold on tight to your phone.
